spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you or a creature within 60 feet of you falls

spells.name: Gift of Gab
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you speak to another creature

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see.

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell

spells.name: Silvery Barbs
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies

spells.name: Temporal Shunt
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, taken when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts to cast a spell
